release_note: No audio re-synthesis in this release; these are the already published, checksum-verified latest V2 audio masters, now with explicit hidden version metadata and cache-specific URLs.

versioning_policy.stable_episode_guid: Episode GUID never changes when correcting/re-rendering an existing episode.
versioning_policy.audio_version: Increment only when the decoded audio content changes; release revision may change independently for site and metadata changes.
versioning_policy.file_identity: SHA-256 verifies exact MP3 bytes; rev query prevents some caches retaining an earlier enclosure with the same base filename.
versioning_policy.visibility: This JSON is public for audits but is not displayed in the site episode interface or Apple Podcasts titles.
versioning_policy.editorial_status: Working narrative-nonfiction edition; independent verse-level and Hebrew pronunciation review still in progress.
versioning_policy.listener_display: Keep podcast titles, descriptions and episode numbers free of version labels. Custom pp:* RSS elements and versions.json are diagnostic metadata; not intended as Apple UI labels.
versioning_policy.backup: The superseded Episode 1 V1 is recoverable from the public repository Git history, but is not linked from the current RSS feed.
